items.label: DOJ-CIVIL civil: Pharmacia & Upjohn
items.detail: Civil False Claims Act settlement announced with the criminal plea in the same release; date is the announcement date. Pfizer Inc. and its subsidiary Pharmacia & Upjohn Company Inc. 'have agreed to pay $2.3 billion': the criminal resolution is $1.3 billion (the separate criminal row) and 'Pfizer has agreed to pay $1 billion to resolve allegations under the civil False Claims Act' ($668,514,830 federal share and $331,485,170 state Medicaid share). Whistleblower suits pending in D. Mass. started the investigation and the U.S. Attorney for D. Mass. led it. Entered under Pharmacia & Upjohn, the ledger's entity for this case.
